summary.text: On Innistrad, already stripped of its protections after Avacyn's death, Nahiri summons Emrakul to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
Emrakul twists plants, animals and people into Eldrazi Horrors and corrupts the remaining angels, while Thalia, Sigarda and a vampire alliance under Olivia Voldaren fight to hold Thraben.
Jace brings the Gatewatch to Innistrad, and at the Battle of Thraben they are saved by Liliana and her Chain Veil.
